subject.title: Preserve legacy watch resume semantics for GUID-linked URL previews

question: Must legacy `--since-rowid` continue accepting the emitted logical event `id` with no replay or loss after GUID-linked preview coalescing, with any physical cursor remaining additive rather than replacing that contract?
rationale: The closed repair demonstrates a viable coalescing direction, but choosing whether a physical completion boundary may change an established public resume token is a compatibility policy decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Preserve legacy `id` semantics
options.body: Keep `id` as the compatible resume input and resolve any folded event completion boundary internally; expose `cursor` only as an additive optional token if needed.

options.title: Adopt cursor as the resume contract
options.body: Document and ship a breaking migration from legacy `id` to a physical cursor, with explicit upgrade guidance and proof that existing consumers cannot silently replay or lose messages.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy `id` semantics
recommendation.body: Keep `id` as the compatible resume input and resolve any folded event completion boundary internally; expose `cursor` only as an additive optional token if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The related repair's closing decision explicitly reserved this compatibility question for an owner decision.
